outcome: Removed three confirmed write-only storage columns with the first forward migration: chat_handoff_resumptions.updated_at, embed_generation_targets.updated_at, and theme_clusters.centroid.

sql: ALTER TABLE chat_handoff_resumptions DROP COLUMN updated_at
ALTER TABLE theme_clusters DROP COLUMN centroid
ALTER TABLE embed_generation_targets DROP COLUMN updated_at
migration.rationale: The launched database regime freezes 0000_baseline.sql. Drizzle generated a forward migration plus linked snapshot/journal artifacts. The emitted SQLite DROP COLUMN statements preserve rows, keys, indexes, checks, and foreign keys without table rebuilds.
migration.preservation_test: A red-first regression applies 0000 alone, seeds populated handoff and generation-target rows plus a real theme cluster/digest assignment graph, adds 0001, applies it, checks foreign-key integrity, proves all rows survived, and proves only the three obsolete columns disappeared. Before generation it failed only because 0001 was missing; after generation it passed.

source_changes.theme_centroid: Removed the persisted schema field, vector custom-type dependency, ClusterDraft carrier, persisted row value, and seven fixture values. CLUSTER_COLS changed from 9 to 8. K-means still computes normalized centroids transiently for assignment and retains its dedicated tests.
source_changes.documentation: Updated active schema, custom-type, and Tier-1 DB comments; historical documents were not changed.
